name: bug
description: Something isn't working: should prefix branch by bug/

name: design
description: design work (Figma), usually a sub-issue of the feat it designs

name: docs
description: Improvements or additions to documentation: should prefix branch by docs/

name: feat
description: New feature or request: should prefix branch by feat/

name: hold:blocked
description: waiting for something outside the team, or for another issue

name: hold:paused
description: deprioritized, or its developer away for a while

name: wontfix
description: This will not be worked on
